notes.title: Flesh Made Fear Demo – Now Haunting Steam Next Fest!
notes.content: [h2][b]The time has come, sinners.[/b][/h2][p][b]Steam Next Fest[/b] has begun, and with it, [b]Flesh Made Fear[/b] is clawing its way onto your screens with a challenging demo that takes you back to your childhood gaming era—playing horror games in the dark of your children's room. If you thought you were ready… think again.[/p][p]This retro-inspired PSX horror experience is here to test your nerves, your instincts—and maybe your soul. Get ready for gritty visuals, relentless tension, and a nightmare that doesn’t play fair.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]By the way ...  the fear becomes real this Halloween already![/b][/h3][previewyoutube="AxDBVgIlp44;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h3]💀 [b]What’s waiting for you in the demo?[/b][/h3][p]A slice of terror from the full game, with brutal encounters, grim environments, and no mercy. Whether you’re a seasoned survivor or fresh meat, we dare you to try.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]The demo will kick your retro PSX butts—and you’ll thank it when it’s over.[/b][/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489218/f31e2ed461a07aa7ec9553141e77759e9e06ae9f.png"][/img][/p][p]We're beyond thrilled to share this glimpse into the horror we’ve been crafting, and we’d love to hear your thoughts. If you enjoyed the demo (or barely made it through), leaving a short review would help us out tremendously.[/p][p]Thanks for playing—and good luck out there. You’ll need it.[/p][p][b]— Michael[/b][/p]

notes.title: Demo Update *Added D-Pad Functionality*
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45489218/0c99eea3dcd1a21a573b3e2357695df364a07796.jpg[/img]

D-pad controls are now fully implemented for character movement in the demo.
Also, fixed a couple of typos on the game and also had Daniel Suraci re-record some of his voice lines. I have now updated his audio files with his new takes!

Thank you for the fantastic response and feedback to the demo so far! I look forward to sharing more with you all as development continues for the full release.
